name: Fred Burgess
original_name: フレッド・バージェス
source:
Favorite tea: Herbal tea. 

He works alongside his older sister at their grandmother’s house in London. He has a charming personality that makes him popular with everyone, though he can be a bit clueless at times. As a result, he’s often scolded by his responsible older sister, but he never lets it get him down. He loves gardening and is often seen out in the garden. He knows a lot about herbs. For him, the benefits of tea matter more than the taste. The Floyd family’s herbal tea is his own creation.
